headline: RPP Infra Projects confirms SEBI-compliant demat processing for Q2 FY26
hook: Routine compliance update for RPP Infra
summary: RPP Infra Projects has officially confirmed that its dematerialization processing for the second quarter of the 2026 fiscal year adheres to SEBI regulations. This procedural update ensures the company remains in line with standard market compliance requirements for share processing. No financial impact or operational changes were announced alongside this filing.
why_it_matters: Ensures continued regulatory compliance for the company's shareholders.
